# EU regulation timeline

> Timeline, legislative procedures and official documents (as Markdown) of EU digital and product regulation: Cyber Resilience Act, NIS-2, Cybersecurity Act 2, AI Act, Digital Omnibus, New Legislative Framework and European Product Act, Machinery Regulation, GPSR, PLD, standardisation.

Unofficial Markdown conversion made for reading and searching; conversion errors are possible. Only the official document linked in `official_source` is authentic. Reuse: © European Union, EUR-Lex. Reuse: Commission Decision 2011/833/EU, Article 6. © European Union, Council of the EU (Council register). Reuse: Council Decision (EU) 2017/1842, Article 6: source acknowledged, meaning not distorted, no liability of the Council. © European Union, European Parliament (EP Open Data Portal). Licence: CC BY 4.0. © European Union, European Commission (Register of Commission documents). Reuse: Commission Decision 2011/833/EU, Article 6. © European Union, European Commission (Commission website). Reuse: Commission Decision 2011/833/EU, Article 6. © European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA). Licence: CC BY 4.0, as stated in the document. © European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA). The document states no licence; reproduced with acknowledgement of the source, as a document of an EU agency. The official document is authentic. © European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA). Reproduction is authorised provided the source is acknowledged, as stated in the document. © European Union, European Commission ("Have your say" portal). A draft by the Commission services published for feedback, not adopted. Reuse: Commission Decision 2011/833/EU, Article 6.
